label: Store name
help: The customer's name for the store, e.g. 7th Ave Park Slope. Shown after the store number.

label: Service type
help: What kind of service this was, in title case, e.g. Quality Control Inspection, Rodent Monitoring Service, Exclusion Service, Mass Trapping Service.

label: Prepared by
help: Name and title, e.g. Timothy Williams, Pest Control Service Supervisor. Blank uses the order's technician.

label: Distribution
default: Chipotle Leadership + Select Exterminating Rodent Control Team

label: Inspection summary
help: Two to four paragraphs: the type and scope of service, the most significant findings, monitoring results and corrective actions completed, and overall conditions needing attention.

label: Findings and assessments
help: In this order, each only when the notes support it: 'Rodent Activity Assessment'; 'Monitoring Device Assessment'; one section per area with a structural or other finding, headed '<Area> – <Finding>' (e.g. 'Serving Line – Exclusion Required', 'Trash Room – Structural Opening'); 'Sanitation Assessment'; 'Moisture Assessment'; 'Service Location Verification'. One to three short paragraphs each.

label: Recommendations
help: Specific, actionable next steps, one per item, each tied to a finding or monitoring result.

label: Conclusion
help: Two to four paragraphs restating the key results, the corrective work still needed, and what continues next.
